svg.title: Fast versus Deep research
svg.desc: Both start from a ranked Today item or a question and end in the same typed action decision. Fast reads up to 8 sources in 12 KB and makes one bounded judgment. Deep reads up to 18 sources in 24 KB, names the most material evidence gap, runs one targeted news or SEC check, adds SEC quarterly financials and reports whether new evidence was found. Valuation is planned.
